description: Open-source, self-hosted deep linking engine (Fastify + PostgreSQL + optional Redis): device-aware redirects, click analytics, deferred deep linking, webhooks, QR codes, link templates, and mobile SDK endpoints. AGPL-3.0. A replacement for Firebase Dynamic Links, Branch, and AppsFlyer OneLink.
rules: Install with `npm install @linkforty/core` and start it with `createServer()`; there is no built-in auth, so wrap the routes with your own.
Requires Node.js 20+ and PostgreSQL 14+; Redis is optional but recommended for link caching.
Short codes are immutable once created.
Hosted docs and the full integration guide live at https://docs.linkforty.com and https://docs.linkforty.com/llms-full.txt.
